task: If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the candidate adds requirements not stated in the task. The hard Response(blocker_moved, target_picked_up) and the hard Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up) have no corresponding sentence or phrase in the task. The task only states the conditional "If you move the ball, you must also take the key" and the unconditional command to pick up the box. The conditional is correctly captured by the hard RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) and the goal by the hard Existence(target_picked_up). Remove the added hard Response(blocker_moved, target_picked_up) and the added hard Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up); keep the RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) and Existence(target_picked_up). Note the compiler also flags RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key) as redundant given the other hard clauses, but the clause is stated by the task so it may be retained; the added order/Response clauses are the defects.
